components.css: .ds-transport-primary { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-progress) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--workbench-progress); color: var(--workbench-selected-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-transport-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-transport-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-progress) 90%, black); } .ds-transport-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--workbench-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-focus) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Control Button
components.description: Compact bordered action for reset, navigation, and secondary transport commands.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--workbench-viewer); color: var(--workbench-foreground); font: 500 12px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-button-outline svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color: var(--workbench-border-strong); background: var(--workbench-hover); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--workbench-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-focus) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Compact Input
components.description: The standard 32px workbench text field with a strong structural edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--workbench-foreground); font: 500 11px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 220px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--workbench-border-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--workbench); color: var(--workbench-foreground); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--workbench-focus); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--workbench-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-focus) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Inspector Tabs
components.description: Square, border-separated workbench navigation with one quiet active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Workbench inspector tabs"><button class="ds-tab">Media</button><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" aria-current="page">Audio</button><button class="ds-tab">Export</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: stretch; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); background: var(--workbench); } .ds-tab { height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 11px/16.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab-active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--workbench-hover) 100%, transparent); color: var(--workbench-foreground); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--workbench-focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-selection-panel { width: 520px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--workbench-timeline); color: var(--workbench-foreground); } .ds-selection-header { height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); } .ds-selection-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-selection-title svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--workbench-progress); } .ds-selection-title code { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 11px/16.5px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-selection-header button { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--workbench-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--workbench-viewer); color: var(--workbench-foreground); } .ds-selection-header button:hover { background: var(--workbench-hover); } .ds-selection-header button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--workbench-focus); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-selection-ruler { position: relative; height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 10px 6px; background: var(--workbench-ruler); color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 11px/16.5px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-selection-ruler i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 52%; width: 2px; background: var(--workbench-playhead); }

narrative.overview:
YAFFW feels like a purpose-built cutting room: dark enough for media to command attention, compact enough to keep every control within working reach, and exact enough that time, capability, and output state remain legible at a glance. Its voice is utilitarian, technical, and no-nonsense; decoration yields to instrument-like feedback.

The system is dense without becoming noisy. Warm-black tonal layers and fine borders organize the workbench, while three accents have strict jobs: Splice Gold marks Selection and active editing intent, Signal Teal reports progress and healthy signal, and Playhead Red locates the current media-time position. Glossy consumer-creator styling and floating dashboard-card layouts are explicit anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Compact system typography with monospaced media-time readouts.
Flat, structurally layered panels separated by borders and tonal shifts.
Sparse semantic accents with stable, task-specific meaning.
Instrument-like controls with visible hover, focus, pressed, disabled, and failure states.

rules.name: The Three Signals Rule
rules.body: Splice Gold means editing intent, Signal Teal means signal or progress, and Playhead Red means current media-time position. Do not swap their roles for variety.

rules.name: The Media Owns Saturation Rule
rules.body: Interface color stays controlled so the loaded video, thumbnails, and waveforms remain the most saturated material on screen.

rules.name: The Instrument Readout Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for media-time, frame, codec, channel, and measured signal values; use system sans for actions and explanations.

rules.name: The Functional Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive and content-bearing text stays at 11px or larger. The 10px micro role is limited to short, non-interactive metadata with strong contrast.

rules.name: The Structural Layering Rule
rules.body: Use tone and borders for permanent hierarchy; use strong shadows only when content truly overlays or projects from its plane.

dos: Do preserve the warm-black tonal sequence from Viewer Black through Transport Black when adding workbench regions.
Do keep accent semantics stable: Splice Gold for editing intent, Signal Teal for signal/progress, and Playhead Red for current position.
Do use borders, alignment, and density to communicate hierarchy before adding shadow or ornament.
Do use monospace for media-time and measured technical values, with system sans for actions and explanations.
Do keep control states explicit through label, icon, border, fill, and focus treatment.
donts: Don't turn the workbench into a glossy consumer-creator interface with gradients, oversized rounded cards, or decorative glow.
Don't build floating dashboard-card layouts inside the editor frame.
Don't reuse semantic accents decoratively or swap their meanings between surfaces.
Don't let permanent panels float with strong shadows; reserve elevation for overlays and the media aperture.
Don't compress interactive labels below 11px or use micro text for primary actions.
Don't imitate a multi-asset nonlinear editor with bins, composition timelines, or gratuitous chrome.
